def transform(grid):
    """Replace the 4x4 marked block with its 180-degree symmetric counterpart."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    if not cells:
        raise ValueError("No marker cells (3) found")
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            out[r-r0][c-c0] = grid[len(grid)-1-r][len(grid[0])-1-c]
    return [row[:c1-c0+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]
PY
